verdict.rationale: Aleph documents its own connector library across ERP and other business systems (150+ no-code integrations). It also claims a single source of truth that keeps financial models in sync, with live data feeding Excel/Sheets models. That supports automated actuals ingestion in principle, but none of the cited evidence names QuickBooks, Xero, or NetSuite, and none describes how actuals flow from the GL into the model. Missing for 10: explicit QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite connectors, documented actuals sync cadence and mapping into models, independent or hands-on corroboration.
